features: Retained v11 flat five-label logistic regression: word TF-IDF 1–2 grams, char_wb TF-IDF 3–5 grams, optional request-derived cues. No annotation, entity, ID, family or parser-derived features.
training: Frozen v15 human development TRAIN families only; never development validation/test, historical inspected tests, calibration or selection
partition_policy: Exact quotas, reviewed/frozen source-bound subset packets, family and normalized-text disjointness across all development/calibration/selection partitions. Exact duplicates excluded before fitting.
selection_policy: Temperature fits calibration only. Configuration and cutoff use selection only: zero UNKNOWN false accepts, then maximize macro-F1, then fewer known abstentions, simpler features, lower C, higher cutoff. No eligible configuration means abstain and NO_GO.
test_policy: Score frozen development test once after selection; validation is diagnostic only. Do not tune from either. Historical inspected tests and predeclared synthetic challenge are safety diagnostics only, never fitting data. First scored result is immutable; further tuning requires another candidate version.
read_authority: Separately validated deterministic v16 full-request/entity/query/scope validation remains authoritative; an ML label grants no read or action. Compare with the unchanged v15 baseline, and separately attribute deterministic/parser gain versus incremental ML gain.
later_gates: 150 fresh independent author/reviewer requests after candidate/parser/threshold/protocol freeze; actual repository/JVM safety validation; Android parity and resource benchmarks after offline gates. No automatic adoption.
report_policy: Ignored build output only; refuse existing attempt directories. BLOCKED is unscored, NO_GO retains scored failure, OFFLINE_GO is not Phase 15 acceptance. Same-user reviewed development and two-calendar-example development test limitations must be disclosed.
